# Legitimate-interest assessment and short impact assessment

Last updated: 2026-10-08. One assessment per source class (decision D10) and one combined, short impact assessment (decision D11).

## Legitimate-interest assessments

### machine-sound-datasets

- **Purpose:** Train and evaluate anomaly detectors for machine sounds.
- **Necessity:** Labelled recordings of faulty machines exist only in research datasets.
- **Balancing:** The recordings are of machines in a factory hall and contain no personal data as far as the publishers state; no balancing against data subjects is needed.
- **Safeguards:** Licence and use check per dataset, data kept outside git with a retention date, no publication of the data.
- **Decided:** 2026-10-08

### imu-activity-datasets

- **Purpose:** Train and evaluate activity recognition on microcontrollers.
- **Necessity:** Labelled IMU windows of many people exist only in research datasets.
- **Balancing:** Volunteers took part in a published study; the publishers identify subjects only by number; the data is not redistributed and the model outputs only an activity class.
- **Safeguards:** Licence and use check per dataset, data kept outside git with a retention date, no publication of the data, no attempt to re-identify subjects, objection channel (PRIVACY.md).
- **Decided:** 2026-10-08

### parliamentary-records

- **Purpose:** Build and evaluate a model that extracts jobs, pains and gains from mobility debates.
- **Necessity:** Public hearings are the main source of stated mobility problems with named actor types; no anonymous equivalent of the same quality exists.
- **Balancing:** Speakers are office holders or invited witnesses speaking in a public, recorded setting intended for publication; texts are not redistributed; the model outputs only spans of the user's own input, never stored records.
- **Safeguards:** Redaction of contact identifiers, texts kept outside git with a retention date, no publication of training text, objection channel (PRIVACY.md), suppression list.
- **Decided:** 2026-10-08

### research-interviews

- **Purpose:** Build and evaluate a model that extracts jobs, pains and gains from interviews.
- **Necessity:** Interviews are the canonical source of jobs-to-be-done evidence.
- **Balancing:** Datasets were published by researchers for reuse, pseudonymised by the publishers; consent basis is recorded per dataset or flagged for an owner decision.
- **Safeguards:** Redaction, no redistribution, retention date, objection channel, suppression list.
- **Decided:** 2026-10-08

### open-papers

- **Purpose:** Build and evaluate a model that extracts jobs, pains and gains from research texts.
- **Necessity:** Papers describe mobility problems with evidence; authors are named only for attribution.
- **Balancing:** Published for reuse under an open licence; the people quoted in papers are mostly anonymised study participants.
- **Safeguards:** Redaction, no redistribution, retention date, attribution in the model card.
- **Decided:** 2026-10-08

### tdm-documents

- **Purpose:** Evaluate extraction quality on realistic, varied texts.
- **Necessity:** A benchmark needs texts beyond openly licensed ones to be representative.
- **Balancing:** Used only for evaluation, never for training or redistribution; opt-outs honoured.
- **Safeguards:** benchmark_only, retention date, no publication of text, deletion when not needed.
- **Decided:** 2026-10-08

### forum-review

- **Purpose:** Evaluate extraction quality on informal user texts, where real pains are stated.
- **Necessity:** Forums are the main source of first-hand user statements in the benchmark.
- **Balancing:** Posts are public but written by private persons; usernames and contact identifiers are redacted before labeling; texts are never used for training or published.
- **Safeguards:** benchmark_only, redaction plus local model review, special categories quarantined, platform terms checked (C-I7), objection channel and suppression list.
- **Decided:** 2026-10-08

### can-bus-datasets

- **Purpose:** Train and evaluate intrusion and spoofing detectors for vehicle networks.
- **Necessity:** Attack recordings with labels exist only in research datasets; recording own attacks on road vehicles is not possible without a test vehicle and a lab.
- **Balancing:** Recordings come from research test vehicles and simulations published for reuse; they may contain vehicle identifiers or positions of the test vehicles, not of private drivers; the data is not redistributed and models output only alarm scores.
- **Safeguards:** Licence and use check per dataset, data kept outside git in a local cache with a retention date, no publication of the data, objection channel (PRIVACY.md).
- **Decided:** 2026-10-08

## Short impact assessment

- **Description:** collection of published texts, redaction, labeling by language models (local first, hosted only through approved routes), training of small extraction models, publication of models without texts.
- **Necessity and proportionality:** only texts needed for the benchmark and the training set; retention bound to the current models; no profiling; models output passages of the user's own input only.
- **Risks for data subjects:** (1) disclosure of texts to hosted model providers outside the EU; (2) re-identification of interview participants or forum users from stored texts; (3) reproduction of collected text in published files; (4) processing of special categories.
- **Measures:** (1) local labeling first, route allowlist, logs of every recipient, privacy notice listing them; (2) redaction before labeling, texts never published, retention dates, deletion log; (3) corpus-overlap scan of every published file (at most 30 consecutive words); (4) special-category quarantine except recorded decisions.
- **Residual risk:** low for published artefacts; medium for past transfers through unpinned hosted routes, which are documented in the privacy notice.
- **Objection and rights:** see PRIVACY.md.
